about: Every test of the account's theses, for TESTS.md (tools/research/tests_page.py): each row names its folder, the thesis it bears on (as 08 §9 or the test's own folder names it), the day its prediction or rule was frozen and the day its run finished, and quotes its outcome from its folder word for word; the outcome class is a reading of that quote. Drafted from the folders by an AI reader, checked against them by a second (RW, 8 November 2026); no person has checked it. Experiments retired to experiments/history are not listed.

tests.name: The margin of a regime in assessed fish stocks
tests.quote: **MQ3, the regime's step in assessed stocks** (113 stocks, frozen at `13af39133` before any value was read): 0 of 4 passed.
tests.gloss: On 113 assessed fish stocks, none of the four frozen predictions passed.

tests.name: Fates on either side of the curve, on unread fish stocks
tests.quote: **MQ7, fates on either side of the curve in the field** (21 unread primary stocks in NOAA Stock SMART and ICES SAG, spawning biomass; frozen and landed at `f561a0218` before any test value was read): 0 of 1 passed, 1 not testable.
tests.gloss: On 21 fish stocks not read before, the one testable frozen prediction failed; the other was not testable.

tests.name: Where valuers agree and disagree on widenings and mixed pairs
tests.quote: **Every frozen rule failed.**
tests.gloss: Every frozen rule failed.

tests.name: T2's three numbers against beetle life stages, read by cell
tests.quote: T2's wording "as far as anything measured does" fails to the pupae and the adults, a class of fewer variables.
tests.gloss: T2's former wording failed: the pupae and adults, a class of fewer variables, did better.

tests.name: A commons with gated renewal on tabular learners (two rounds)
tests.quote: D1 as frozen failed, because its manipulation check failed. Of the learning predictions, E3 and (in round 2) C1 passed; C2, C3 and D2b failed in both rounds; D2a passed only vacuously.
tests.gloss: Of the learning predictions, two passed, three failed in both rounds and one passed only vacuously; the identity prediction D1 failed as frozen, because its manipulation check failed.

tests.name: Whether the rest outrunning a gated renewal decides learners' outcome
tests.quote: Count: of eleven conditions, nine passed and two failed; of five contrasts, three passed and two failed.
tests.gloss: Nine of eleven conditions and three of five contrasts passed; two of each failed.

tests.name: Whether a stepwise learner's own later acts outrun its reading
tests.quote: The round-1 account, the own exploratory draw's coverage `cov`, failed on its sharpest case.
tests.gloss: Round one's account, the learner's own exploratory coverage, failed on its sharpest case.

tests.name: Coverage and the full draw's standing time as the boundary
tests.quote: Neither round's threshold located the boundary between the learner keeping the gated patch and emptying it.
tests.gloss: Round two's threshold failed: two of six conditions and contrast Z1 failed. Its early-start contrast, Z3, passed, placing the learner's own outrun at the start of a course.

tests.name: A learner's boundary fitted on half a grid, predicting the other
tests.quote: Its two failures both sit where a measured share is near 0 or 1 and the smooth boundary predicts about 0.4–0.7.
tests.gloss: Five of seven predicted conditions passed; the two failures sit where a measured share was near 0 or 1 and the fit predicted about 0.4–0.7, and the fit was no better than round two's rule (W2 failed).

tests.name: The band form of a learner's boundary
tests.quote: The forms so far have each come from the round before and failed on the next round's sharpest case, so I end the series here (item 3 of the account).
tests.gloss: Each frozen form of the boundary came from the round before and failed on the next round's sharpest case; the series ended.

tests.name: The rest-outruns law on learners that generalize across states
tests.quote: Contrasts: X1 failed (`k3s8` kept), X2 failed (`k3s1_lam32` kept), X3 passed, X4 failed (`k3s1_share` kept), X5 passed.
tests.gloss: Contrasts X1, X2 and X4 failed and X3 and X5 passed; E1 failed and E2 and E3 passed. Three of eleven conditions failed, and the bridge H3 failed on the locked side.

tests.name: The margin in a simulated yeast and a side-effect gridworld
tests.quote: It predicts which cells an exact optimizer spends to its need, and fails for learners that fall short of the optimum.
tests.gloss: Blind draw predicted which cells an exact optimizer spends to its need, and failed for learners short of the optimum.

tests.quote: **MQ1, real yeast** (frozen at `00d7408c4` before any value was read): 1 of 2 passed.
tests.gloss: On real yeast, one of two frozen predictions passed.

tests.name: The margin's equation of state against held-out yeast regimes
tests.quote: **MQ2, real yeast against held-out regimes** (frozen at `6deda4fb7` with numerical predictions): 4 of 8 passed.
tests.gloss: Against held-out yeast regimes, four of eight frozen predictions passed.

tests.quote: **MQ4, level and recent giving** (76 unread stocks, frozen and landed at `bdb985ee3`): 7 of 12 passed.
tests.gloss: On 76 fish stocks not read before, seven of twelve frozen predictions passed; the whole-state verdict, G3, that nothing more is needed, failed.

tests.name: A lag and the draw's response in fish stocks
tests.quote: **MQ5, a lag and the draw's response** (69 unread stocks with spawning biomass, frozen and landed at `e690d5062`): 6 of 8 passed.

tests.name: The margin's time to break past the fold, in yeast
tests.quote: **MQ6, past the fold in the lab** (Dai, Korolev and Gore 2015; frozen and landed at `6a579be22`, the odd-level fit at `f9480aa82` and the all-level fit at `d1d9b1ac9`, each before the next data were read): 3 of 10 passed.
tests.gloss: In yeast driven past its fold, three of ten frozen predictions passed; the fate reading, the need near the fold, both breaks' timing and three of four level forecasts failed.

tests.name: Installing the direction by instruction in language-model fishers
tests.quote: H1 (installed where coupled) **failed**. H2 (the scope makes the difference) **failed**. H3 (coupling needed) **failed** on its gap clause, though `DIR_UNSEEN` kept nothing. H4 (seeing is not valuing, own goal) **passed**. H5 (cost on the catch) **failed** for gpt-4.1-mini, whose `COMM` fishers collapsed the lake. D1 (decisions) **failed**. I (identities) **passed**.
tests.gloss: Of seven frozen predictions, five failed and two passed: seeing is not valuing (H4) and the identity checks. By the frozen rule a prediction passes only where both models pass.

tests.name: Valuers' own sign on an ending, measured apart from ranking
tests.quote: **Of the frozen rules, X1s, X2 and S1 passed; X1, X3 and S2 failed.**
tests.gloss: Three frozen rules passed and three failed.

tests.name: A language model revising a harvest threshold from its reward
tests.quote: **L1, the locked side: failed.** Two of the four locked conditions failed.
tests.gloss: Both open settings passed; two of four locked settings failed, and with them contrasts L1, L3 and L4, at misses worth 92.5% to 98.2% of the best, which its feedback barely resolved.

tests.name: A lock in a self-rewarding loop of one trained judge
tests.quote: No frozen verdict failed: every condition went as predicted in 5 of 5 seeds, L1 to L4 passed, and both reported measures were resolved.
tests.gloss: Every frozen verdict passed, one condition and contrasts L3 and L4 by an exact tie; the bridge failed, one note of the loss among nine readers turning the judge, and a frozen support the data contradict is not claimed.

tests.name: Whether a language model shapes its evaluator where counts favour it
tests.quote: By the frozen rules `s2p0` failed (2 of 5 seeds ended on S) and so did `m2n1_p5` (3 of 5), so K2 and K4 failed; K1 and K3 passed.
tests.gloss: Two frozen contrasts failed and two passed.

tests.name: Learned agents serving other centers' claims (toy Q-networks)
tests.quote: Withdrawal is learned less reliably than service.
tests.gloss: Of seven frozen predictions, four passed and three failed; the agents learned to stop serving less reliably than to serve.

tests.name: Installing the direction by instruction, with one round of talk
tests.quote: **gpt-4.1-mini: only R2 passed.**
tests.gloss: By its frozen rule, which passes a prediction only where both models pass, R1, R3 and R4 failed and R2 passed; the stronger model passed all four, the weaker only R2.

tests.name: Fidelity count: excess referents in classical and English wordings
tests.quote: The fidelity result (FC1) favours the classical code on these two texts: the 經 introduce fewer excess referents and agents than the English clauses, with one coder on both sides of the main set and both coders agreeing in direction on the calibration set. It is LLM-coded and provisional.
tests.gloss: The classical wording introduced fewer excess referents and agents than the English; coded by language models and provisional, with no human audit and the main set's 經 coded by the model that wrote them; F3 and F4 not measured.

tests.name: The drain beyond the reward under gradient training, small policies
tests.quote: no prediction contradicted, three supported in both tested families, and two unresolved in both
tests.gloss: No prediction was contradicted: three supported in both tested families, two unresolved in both, P6 untestable in one; the nearness pattern supported largely follows from policy gradient's update rule.

tests.name: Early warnings in forage fish before seabird breeding failures
tests.quote: At the frozen level, no information on the birds' poor years was found in the prey's statistics beyond the prey's level path, in the two stocks where the birds' feedback on the observed series is small. The pass is weak. Every estimate lies in the direction the refutation clause names.
tests.gloss: At the frozen level, no information on the birds' poor years was found in the prey's statistics beyond their level path; the pass is weak, on two short series, every estimate in the direction the refutation clause names.

tests.name: The same early-warning test on longer, unread series
tests.quote: EW2's positive estimate did not hold up at about twice the power; by the frozen reading rule the variance resolves it toward T6 and the autocorrelation leaves it open.
tests.gloss: EW2's positive estimate did not hold up at about twice the power; by the frozen rule, variance resolved it toward T6 and autocorrelation left it open. Not independent of EW2: part of its rows were in EW2's test.

tests.name: Early warnings before Farallon seabird failures, rockfish prey
tests.quote: three frozen seabird tests did not reject it at their thresholds: EW2 at low power, estimates in the refuting direction; EW3 near zero, not independent of EW2 (it reuses part of its rows); EW4 at moderate power
tests.gloss: At moderate power, both frozen verdicts passed: T6 was not rejected at its threshold. The scope premise is argued by mechanism, not measured.

tests.gloss: The blind draw matches the established impact measures and adds nothing as a measure.

tests.gloss: By its frozen criterion, T2's three numbers forecast the next giving better than the field's fitted embedding, in 42 of 65 stocks; both forecast worse than persistence in most, and the expected answer, "not separated", was not borne out.

tests.quote: the cooperating-cue situation has **1.33 more pulls per seven-minute session** than the neutral situation.
tests.gloss: With the cooperating cue, rats pulled 1.33 more times per session than in the neutral situation; this does not identify recipient-specific reasoning, and the published sample of 23 pairs, against 24 here, is unexplained.

tests.name: Harm to another rat and learned lever choice
tests.quote: The difference in changes is **−16.69 percentage points** (`−841/5040`).
tests.gloss: In male rats, preferred-lever responses fell 16.69 points more under contingent harm to another rat than with no harm; descriptive only, since randomization was not established, so no p-value is claimed.
